news.title: Rockstar 表示，GTA 6 不会在细节上妥协
news.summary: Rockstar's games are known for their impressive attention to detail, along with their massive scopes, and GTA

content.v: Rockstar's games are known for their impressive attention to detail, along with their massive scopes, and GTA 6 is seemingly going to up the ante in that regard. Rockstar boss Aaron Garbut said in an interview that a developer might compromise scale for detail or detail for interaction "but not with this project."

"We went the other way," he told Game Informer . "Everything is dialed up--detail, scope, breadth, scale, interaction, and density." He went on to say Rockstar has never "created anything close to this before."
"As the pressure for us on this project is huge, we dealt with that by doing our best to overdeliver," Garbut said.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_08.jpg?w=636

No game can have everything, though, and GTA 6 is no different. The game takes place in Florida stand-in Leonida but doesn't feature Walt Disney World , for example, but Rockstar says the game will deliver the "full Florida experience."
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game has reportedly already sold close to 6 million copies, generating more than $570 million in pre-sales.
Also this week, Rockstar revealed that GTA 6 will have more than 170 animal species , including cane toads and monkeys. We also learned that GTA 6 has a new dynamic weather system .

news.title: 前钢人队主教练透露他已经建造了 12 年的 Minecraft 城市
news.summary: Mike Tomlin served as head coach of the Pittsburgh Steelers from 2007-2025, which is a remarkably long tenure

content.v: Mike Tomlin served as head coach of the Pittsburgh Steelers from 2007-2025, which is a remarkably long tenure in the NFL. During more than half of that time, Tomlin was secretly working on a massive Minecraft city, and he's now revealing it to the general public.

In the first episode of his deep dive into the Minecraft city--and the first video on his YouTube channel--Tomlin shared how the city began, initially with his kids' participation, but as they grew older, it became more and more of a focus for him alone. Much like the Steelers' roster changed every season, Tomlin remained the constant.

As you can see in the video, Mike Tomlin put an enormous amount of effort and time into building this city, not only creating the skyscrapers and nearby neighborhoods, but also sports stadiums. He said in the first episode that he'd go into more detail on these stadiums later, but the city includes a baseball field and a soccer pitch, alongside the obvious football field.
His son Mayce also shared that Tomlin would sometimes take his PlayStation, presumably due to a sudden creative spark.

Tomlin has a lot more time to focus on Minecraft since resigning as the Steelers' head coach following the 2025 season. During his tenure, the team famously never had a losing season, which might just change this year with a grandfather at quarterback and a defense that has major issues stopping the run. Pittsburgh native Mike McCarthy is the team's new head coach, and it's unclear if he plays Minecraft.

news.title: PUBG：黑色预算取消，加入直播服务墓地
news.summary: PUBG publisher Krafton has pulled the plug on its extraction shooter spin-off PUBG: Black Budget . Announced l

content.v: PUBG publisher Krafton has pulled the plug on its extraction shooter spin-off PUBG: Black Budget . Announced less than a year ago and already through several closed alpha tests, the publisher's reasoning for the cancellation is simple: it believes Black Budget simply wasn't fun enough to keep potential players engaged.

"After reviewing the project's development status and future direction, we concluded that its current direction would not allow us to deliver an experience players could enjoy over the long term," Krafton wrote in a Steam update . "We have therefore made the difficult decision to end development of PUBG: Black Budget. PUBG Studios will carry what we learned from development and testing into future projects, continuing to listen to players as we explore new gameplay experiences."

Black Budget is the second PUBG spin-off to get the axe, following the demise of the tactical shooter PUBG: Blindspot in March. While the game launched in early access, Krafton closed it down after two months, saying it was "no longer able to sustainably provide the level of experience" it set out to deliver.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Black-Budget.jpg?w=636

Krafton's reasons for cancelling Black Budget aren't without merit. If it had been fully released, Black Budget would likely have faced an uphill battle, as the extraction shooter genre is perceived as a niche market dominated by a handful of games, while the live-service video game graveyard is full of recent projects that failed to find an audience. Many games launch with strong momentum, but they struggle to retain those initial player numbers, and their audiences shrink quickly.

Just look at Highguard , as the free-to-play shooter lasted just over a month before it shut down. PUBG franchise director Taeseok Jang recently reflected on the struggles of Highguard and other live-service games, commenting on how hard it is to succeed in that space.

Krafton has another PUBG spin-off in the works, the grindhouse-themed multiplayer shooter Ded.Net. Announced back in August during Gamescom, it's currently being developed by Krafton's Wisconsin-based studio PUBG Madison.

news.title: 《战锤 40,000：星际战士 2》锁定了令人垂涎的盾牌，价格为 6 美元 Twitch Sub 付费专区，粉丝们都沸腾了
news.summary: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 players are up in arms over a coveted shield that is locked behind a Twitch p

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/08/07/space-marine-2-1723069299374.jpg
Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 players are up in arms over a coveted shield that is locked behind a Twitch paywall.

Space Marine 2’s 15.0 update launched today and with it came a new set of Twitch drops. Nothing particularly special there, except the fact you need to buy one new recurring or gift subscription ($6) to claim the Victrix Guard Shield.

Fans have called on developer Saber to add this shield to Space Marine 2 ever since the game launched two years ago. It appears briefly in the campaign, with an Ultramarine holding it more in the background of the Battle Barge than anything else. It’s not been available for players to wield before.

As you’d expect, the prospect of handing $6 to Twitch just for one shield has caused quite the stink within the Space Marine 2 community. “I'm not gonna pay for a sub I'm not gonna use,” one person complained. “I just paid 39€ for the year 3 pass, which should be more than enough.” Added another: "I don't know about you all but my ass isn't paying 6 bucks for a shield."

“Incredible levels of greed,” another person said. “I don’t even use Twitch except to get these rewards and you’re telling me that after throwing 40 dollars on a season pass I need to give even more money to some random goober on Twitch to get the shield????” another complained. “lmao this shield has been on the campaign since day 1 and the only way you can get it 2 years later is via twitch stream,” another added. “Hilarious honestly.”

Reps for the game have confirmed that the shield will be made available via the Accolades shop in a future update, but there’s no word when that will be. So, for now, we really do have a Space Marine 2 shield locked behind a $6 Twitch paywall.

The Space Marine 2 Discord and subreddit are packed with similar complaints over this. Space Marine 2 generally speaking has a good reputation for its live service monetization, with only the occasional misstep (voice packs!) from publisher Focus and developer Saber. So this situation with the shield is something of an outlier.
"Sometimes they astonish me with the decision they take," one fan commented. "They'll be cooking and then do absolute doodoo feces like this. What the f**k?"

news.title: 迪士尼 Lorcana Hyperia City：独家 Héctor Rivera 和 Tiana 卡揭晓
news.summary: Disney Lorcana’s last booster set of the year, Hyperia City, is almost upon us with more beautiful Disney card

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/25/dlorc-10-1-1790296185453.jpg

Disney Lorcana’s last booster set of the year, Hyperia City, is almost upon us with more beautiful Disney cards to peruse. We’re happy to exclusively reveal two new cards in this upcoming set with the Epic Héctor Rivera Street Magician and Enchanted Tiana Party Hostess.

Continuing the Pixar additions, Coco makes an appearance in the card game for the first time. That means players and fans will get to see more characters like Héctor Rivera from the Land of the Dead. And even though The Princess and the Frog has already been introduced in Lorcana, we’re also getting an amazing new Enchanted Tiana card featuring her in a new party dress.

Both cards emphasize discard, so both can fit in just fine in decks that manipulate the discard pile and possibly recur any discarded cards back into play. Enchanted Tiana Party Hostess is a great example of this, with the opportunity to play a very costly location for free as long as it’s discarded via her ability. It’ll be interesting to see if there’s a new location in the upcoming set that synergizes specifically with this new Tiana.

Disney Lorcana Hyperia City is set to release on October 23, with pre-release events starting as early as October 16 at your local game stores. For more Disney Lorcana, check out our hands-on impressions of the last set, Attack of the Vine! , and our breakdown of the Collection Starter Set - Stitch Edition .

news.title: 不要害怕 BIOS 更新：华硕刚刚修复了影响旧版英特尔主板的本地访问漏洞
news.summary: To be clear, it's only older motherboards for 8th and 9th Gen Intel CPUs that are affected by the issue.

content.v: I'll be honest: BIOS updates give me the willies. Unfortunately, even as such a source of undue anxiety, they are still well worth staying on top of. Case in point, the latest BIOS update from Asus addresses a vulnerability found in motherboards for 8th and 9th Gen Intel chips.

The vulnerability in question is described as "Improper initialization in an ASUS certain motherboard [sic] allows an physically proximate user to read or write arbitrary memory by inserting a specially crafted device." Basically, a bad actor would need to be in the same room as an affected PC to exploit this vulnerability. Even though local access is required, it's still a pretty serious issue.

Designated CVE-2026-93495 , the issue has a high severity score of 7.0. As such, Asus has issued a security bulletin earlier today saying it "strongly recommends updating to the latest version" of the BIOS for a list of affected motherboards.
The affected motherboards include a number of ROG Strix and ROG Maximus models. I've included the full list of models, plus the fixed BIOS update that Asus recommends downloading, below:

news.title: 玩家多到装不下！《魔兽无限》再扩服务器：疯狂涌入
news.summary: 玩家多到装不下！《魔兽无限》再扩服务器：疯狂涌入

content.v: 《魔兽世界：无限》Beta测试近期火爆程度超出暴雪预期，官方甚至不得不连续提高服务器人口上限。暴雪高级游戏设计师Josh Greenfield此前表示，这是自己在公司工作17年来见过的“最疯狂的数据”，Beta上线初期甚至一度因为玩家数量过多导致服务器出现压力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282016049294.png
为了应对不断增长的玩家规模，开发团队此前已经通过提高人口上限缓解拥堵，但这种措施如今又被再次启用。9月27日，《魔兽世界》执行制作人兼副总裁Holly Longdale在社交平台发文确认：“我们不得不再次提高《魔兽世界：无限》Beta的人口上限，这场疯狂旅程还在继续。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282016339729.png
目前官方没有说明此次调整具体针对欧美哪个服务器区域，不过从全球玩家反馈来看，项目热度相当明显。值得注意的是，这次Beta并非完全免费，玩家至少需要支付59.99美元才能参与，但依然吸引了大量玩家进入。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282017488705.png
《魔兽世界：无限》此前就被暴雪定位为面向大量已经淡出经典《魔兽世界》的老玩家，同时也希望吸引全新的用户群体。如今Beta持续出现人数过多的问题，至少说明目前玩家参与热情相当高。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282017575625.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282018002136.jpg

news.title: 谷歌日本的传送带键盘令人悲伤地提醒我们整个公司很久很久以前曾经拥有的幽默感
news.summary: Google Japan has form, pity it's seemingly the only bit of Google that still does.

content.v: Is this a piss take? Okay, this is definitely a piss take. Google Japan has posted a YouTube video showcasing the new Gboard Conveyor Belt Version . What we are talking about here, people, is "a keyboard whose keys are delivered straight to your finger tips." Literally.

Turns out, Google Japan has form with this kind of thing, what with the rotary keyboard and absurdly-long-stick-of-single-keys keyboard , er, keyboards they've done before. But this conveyor-belt board? This one might just be the best of all.

The keyboard has four columns of vertically stacked keys that rotate on a belt, the idea being that you don't move your hand, you just wait for the right key to arrive. As the video explains, "just as conveyor belts ramped up factory productivity, we wondered if we could streamline typing in the exact same way." Well, quite.

"This key advancement allows you to fluidly convey your ideas," Google's Japan team explains, adding, "with keys streaming under your fingertips, it ushers in a whole new era of touch-and-go typing. You touch. It goes."
Google Japan says it's working on further developments of the concept, including multiple colourways and a high speed mode "ideal for developing hand-eye coordination."

There are also swap-in cardboard key caps that enable daily nail care in the works. But my favourite planned feature? That'll be a new "voice guide" mode, where the keyboard reads out the passing keys aloud. Perfect. As the Japan team concludes, this is "a keyboard to come, built for the era to come."

Actually, there's a tinge of sadness to all this in that it's a reminder of what Google used to be like before it IPO'ed itself into the ruthless, humourless cyborg money-making machine the company has become today. Somehow, wonderfully, it seems Google Japan didn't get that memo.

news.title: 修补程序 5.00c 现已推出！
news.summary: Hotfix 5.00c is now available for download for the Steam version of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered. You

content.v: Hotfix 5.00c is now available for download for the Steam version of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered. You'll find the patch notes below:
Fixed an issue where the game couldn't be saved or loaded if the path to the Documents folder contained special characters.
Fixed an issue where voiceover audio could become significantly quieter than other in-game audio after navigating through the pause menu tabs.
Made various visual adjustments in Velen, including tweaks to Bloom, vegetation lighting, saturation, and Path Tracing lighting.
Reverted a change that caused significant performance and visual issues with HairWorks enabled for some users.
Fixed an issue where marketing telemetry settings weren't saved properly.
Fixed an issue where it wasn't possible to launch the Classic (1.32) version of the game.
Once again, thank you for your patience as we continue investigating the issues you report.

news.title: 据报道《神秘海域 5》正在开发中，内森·德雷克将主演
news.summary: Naughty Dog is focused on releasing its first new IP since 2013's The Last of Us in Intergalactic: The Heretic

content.v: Naughty Dog is focused on releasing its first new IP since 2013's The Last of Us in Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet , but a new report suggests it is also busy with the revival of its biggest franchise.

According to MP1st , and corroborated by VGC , Naughty Dog could be developing Uncharted 5, a sequel to a series that last saw an entry in 2017. The report claims that Uncharted: The Lost Legacy director Shaun Escayag is leading the project, after briefly leaving Naughty Dog to work on Crystal Dynamic's ill-fated Avengers . It's suggested that Uncharted 5 will be the studio's next release after Intergalactic, with The Last of Us 3 coming afterwards. That would align with Naughty Dog's recent announcement that it is working on multiple new Last of Us projects.

The report doesn't have too many details on the game itself, outside of mentioning that the series' main protagonist, Nathan Drake, will be present in some capacity. That could leave the door open for Cassie Drake, Nathan's daughter who appears at the end of Uncharted: 4 A Thief's End, to potentially take over as the series' lead going forward. This latest entry is also apparently not a remake of any sort, with Naughty Dog reportedly shelving those plans a long time ago.

Uncharted 4 was positioned as the definitive end for Nathan Drake's story when it released in 2016, but Naughty Dog has repeatedly suggested that it is not done with the franchise . Escayag himself stated in 2022 that it's a world the studio wants to see more of, saying “I think we can say for certain that we can never say never." In February of this year, he posted a vague Instagram photo of a cannon in a tropical environment that was captioned “research," suggesting that he might be working on something related to Uncharted.

When Uncharted 5 might release is anyone's guess, but it's more likely that it'll arrive on the PlayStation 6 given that Sony is expected to release its next-generation console sometime in 2028. Intergalatic, the studio's most imminent project, will be revealed in full in 2027, with a release window still unknown.

news.title: Xbox 为小岛秀夫 Physint 支付的费用远低于正常水平，可能低于 2 亿美元 - 报告
news.summary: New Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has made a lot of big moves since taking over for Phil Spencer in the role, one of wh

content.v: New Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has made a lot of big moves since taking over for Phil Spencer in the role, one of which was signing Hideo Kojima's new spy-thriller game, Physint , after Sony walked away from it.

According to The New York Times , Xbox's agreement with Kojima was "substantially below what Xbox would typically spend to develop a premium game." What exactly would be typical, however, is unknown, because game studios are incredibly secretive about budgets.

The money figures for Physint have been a point of contention, with unconfirmed reports that Physint's budget at Sony was $400 million. This has never been confirmed, but it was also reported that one of the reasons Sony opted to drop Kojima and Physint was that the game was over budget and late .

Windows Central's Jez Corden said he was told by first-hand sources with "direct knowledge of the contracts" for Physint at Xbox that the real number is "far lower." He said the deal between Xbox and Kojima amounts to only a "fraction" of the reported figure.

The Game Business reporter Chris Dring, who originated the $400 million rumor, said he was only speculating, and the internet did what the internet does. He subsequently stated that he understands that Xbox is paying "far, far less," and "possibly even below $200 million."

Xbox's deal with Kojima for Physint also covers film and TV adaptations . Physint stars Bill Skarsgard as its lead , along with Charlee Fraser, Don Lee, and Minami Hamabe. The game doesn't have a release date or any footage as of yet. Kojima believes Physint could become his most commercial game yet .

Kojima said he got the idea for Physint in part due to the overwhelming fan demand for another Metal Gear game . He no longer works at Konami and couldn’t make a new Metal Gear, but the interest from fans inspired him to make a “new action espionage game” that became Physint.

Sony originally announced that it would publish Physint, but the company told Kojima over Zoom that it was terminating the deal . Kojima's previous game franchise with Sony, Death Stranding, reportedly barely broke even .
Sharma also briefly discussed Xbox's relationship with PlayStation, saying the two companies currently work together and that will continue under her leadership.
"Competition and collaboration can coexist," she said.
Physint is not the only Kojima game that Xbox is publishing, as the company is also partnered with the studio for the horror game OD .

news.title: 《巫师3重制》画面引发争议！被批不如原版
news.summary: 《巫师3：狂猎重制版》是2015年CDPR经典奇幻冒险RPG《巫师3：狂猎》的现代重制，已于9月29日正式上线，所有已经拥有原版游戏的玩家…

content.v: 由你来说： 你认为《巫师3：狂猎重制版》的画面升级是否达到了预期？面对更加精细的细节、更强的光照效果，以及与原版不同的整体氛围，你更喜欢新版的视觉表现，还是认为原版的风格更加经典？欢迎在评论区分享你的看法。
《巫师3：狂猎重制版》是2015年CDPR经典奇幻冒险RPG《巫师3：狂猎》的现代重制，已于9月29日正式上线，所有已经拥有原版游戏的玩家均可免费升级。
而据Kotaku报道，目前有一部分声音十分响亮的玩家群体并不认可游戏更新后的画面表现，在改进后的光线追踪效果以及全面重做的光照系统下，大量新的视觉细节得到了展现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011007587224.jpg
不少玩家表示，相比重制版，他们更喜欢原版的视觉效果，认为原版在明暗对比、色彩氛围以及整体质感方面更符合游戏气质。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011004169746.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011004177692.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011004174706.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011004184933.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011004193308.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011004196783.png
不过，也有玩家认为，新版画面表现同样出色，新增的细节和光影效果让部分场景拥有了更强的真实感与沉浸感。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011004448789.png
与此同时，还有玩家指出，重制版的问题并非出在整体画质提升上，而是在部分光照、色彩调校等细节处理方面存在不足，导致一些场景的观感与原版相比有所变化。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011005119184.png
目前，CD Projekt Red尚未公布是否会针对重制版的视觉表现进行进一步调整。至少在PC平台上，对于更喜欢原版体验的玩家而言，可以直接进入自己的Steam游戏库，选择下载此前的版本，而不是最新的重制版本。
那么，你对《巫师3：狂猎重制版》的画面表现满意吗？你认为新版的升级是否保留了原作的独特氛围，还是改变了游戏原本的视觉风格？欢迎在评论区留下你的观点，与其他玩家一起讨论。

news.title: PS线下店设“女友寄放区”引争议！女玩家直呼不适
news.summary: 中国台湾首家PlayStation概念店近日正式开幕，不过店内一处休息区域的标语，却意外成为网友讨论的焦点。

content.v: 由你来说： PlayStation概念店设“女友寄放区”标牌，本意是玩“男友寄放区”的反向梗，却让部分女玩家感到不适，也有人觉得只是轻松调侃、没必要上纲上线。你觉得这种标语是幽默还是欠妥？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011532307704.png
中国台湾首家PlayStation概念店近日正式开幕，不过店内一处休息区域的标语，却意外成为网友讨论的焦点。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011532322744.png
有网友在社交媒体晒出店内照片，可以看到休息座位旁设置了一块“女友寄放区”的标牌。由于标语本身颇具调侃意味，很快在玩家之间引发不同看法。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011532476796.png
这一设计似乎是在借鉴服饰、饰品等女性消费场所的“男友寄放区”玩梗，将原本的说法反过来使用。其想表达的意思大致是，陪伴另一半来到店里的玩家如果对店内商品不感兴趣，可以在这里休息等待。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011533494705.png
不过，这种说法也遭到部分女性玩家质疑。有女玩家直言对此感到不适，并指出女性玩家在游戏群体中同样占有相当比例。还有玩家表示自己拥有的大量白金奖杯，认为PlayStation玩家并不能简单按照性别进行这样的区分。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011533406974.png
与此同时，也有网友认为没必要过度解读这块立牌。在他们看来，这不过是将其他商店常见的“男友寄放区”进行反向改编的趣味玩梗，并不代表PlayStation将女性玩家排除在外。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011534128753.png
对于这场争议，也有网友提出了更中性的解决办法，例如将“女友寄放区”改成“伴侣寄放区”或“家属休息区”，既保留休息区域的功能，也能避免因性别表述引发不必要的争议。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011534126731.png

news.title: PS港服三档会员免费送一年！索尼发疯了？
news.summary: 0元获取千元级订阅，明显违背产品正常定价，可能属于系统错误带来的不当得利，平台有权利纠错，收回异常权益。

content.v: 近日，各大社区有用户晒出截图证实，部分PS账号商店页面出现100%全额折扣福利，原价1000港币的12个月PS Plus三档高级会员，直接显示0港币可免费领取。不少幸运玩家顺利下单，成功续费一年顶级会员权益，事件也迅速引爆各大游戏社区。
编辑观点： 0元获取千元级订阅，大概率属于系统错误带来的不当得利，平台有权利纠错，收回异常权益。但错误来自平台后台配置失误，不是玩家恶意破解；玩家正常在前端界面完成操作，过错方是平台，后果不该由普通玩家承担。如果事后随意收回已经生效的订阅权益，会让玩家对PS商店界面产生不信任，以后看到任何优惠都要怀疑是不是bug。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011529176589.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011529246567.png
根据玩家实拍界面信息，优惠标注为全年全额减免，有效期持续至2026年12月17日，到期后续订将恢复千元原价。玩家成功订阅后，系统已正常生效三档会员全部权限，包含联机对战、游戏库畅玩、经典游戏目录、专属试玩、云存档与会员独占福利等全套高级权益。
值得一提的是，该福利并非全服普发活动，仅少量随机账号刷新出该优惠入口，普通用户无法主动触发。目前索尼官方尚未发布任何公告解释本次异常，既没有承认福利活动，也没有表态是否会回滚、收回已生效的BUG订单。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011529379316.png
不少老玩家直言，这很有可能是索尼的商城BUG，如果事后一旦官方开启“事后随意回收正规界面订单”的先例，未来玩家看到任何超低折扣、限时优惠，都会第一时间怀疑是BUG、不敢放心购买，最终伤害的是长期积累的平台口碑与用户粘性。
客观来说，索尼在法理与规则层面确实拥有修正重大配置错误、撤销异常权益的权限，本次0元千元会员或许也属于非常规漏洞福利。但站在玩家与行业口碑角度，平台自身失误不该让普通用户背锅。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011530194840.png
单纯一刀切回收所有已生效订单，短期看似挽回损失，长期却会透支玩家信任、破坏商店交易安全感。最优解应当是官方公开表态、酌情处理，而非无声清算或装死无视，无论留福利还是收回，透明交代才是平息争议的关键。
你觉得这是索尼发福利还是临时工？欢迎在评论区聊聊你的看法。

others.title: 据报道顽皮狗正在开发内森·德雷克的新《神秘海域》游戏

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610010827236572.png
据外媒爆料，顽皮狗目前正在开发一款全新的《神秘海域》游戏，并非此前传闻中的初代重制版。消息人士称，该项目预计将成为《星际：异端先知》之后，顽皮狗下一款开发并发售的作品，而《最后生还者3》则排在其后。不过由于项目仍处于较早阶段，相关计划未来仍可能发生变化。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610010827302623.png
此次新作最大的悬念在于主角。消息人士透露，内森·德雷克仍会以某种形式出现在新作中，但究竟是主角、配角还是客串，目前尚无法确认。《神秘海域4》结尾已经交代内森进入人生后期，并与女儿共同生活，因此此前玩家猜测可能由女儿接班继续冒险，但目前并没有确切消息证明这一点。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610010827377535.png
负责新作的导演据称是肖恩·埃斯卡伊格（Shaun Escayg）。他此前曾担任《漫威复仇者联盟》创意总监，同时也是《神秘海域：失落的遗产》的导演，对这一系列拥有直接开发经验。
《神秘海域》主线自2016年的《神秘海域4》后长期没有推出新作，《失落的遗产》则是系列首次没有以内森作为主角的作品。如今随着顽皮狗确认正在开发多个《最后生还者》相关项目，再加上《星际：异端先知》，工作室未来的项目版图也逐渐浮出水面。

news.title: 《巫师3》DLC旧时曲公布新情报！根据玩家进度调整
news.summary: “旧时曲”是《巫师3：狂猎》在“血与酒”发布近10年后将推出的全新DLC，由Fool's Theory与CD Projekt Red合作开发，将于2027年正式…

content.v: “旧时曲”是《巫师3：狂猎》在“血与酒”发布近10年后将推出的全新DLC，由Fool's Theory与CD Projekt Red合作开发，将于2027年正式推出，登陆PC、Xbox与PS5平台。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011023346714.jpg
据PCGamesN报道，近日在接受采访时，主创团队介绍了这条新故事线将如何衔接玩家在游戏中已经完成或尚未完成的各种经历。
据了解，“旧时曲”的故事发生在此前的两款扩展“石之心”和“血与酒”的剧情之后，按照剧情，此时的杰洛特已经选择隐退养老，但在“旧时曲”当中，杰洛特选择为自己的挚友丹德里恩再提供一次帮助。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011023445090.jpg
虽然故事发生的时间点更靠后，但《往昔之歌》并不会要求玩家必须通关《石之心》或《血与酒》后才能开始游玩。不过，游戏会根据玩家是否体验过这些内容做出对应调整。只要你完成了《巫师3：狂猎》本体的主线任务，杰洛特和丹德里恩就可以启程前往新的区域。
Fool's Theory创意总监Karolina Kuzia-Rokosz表示：“当然，我们会根据玩家是否完成了第二个扩展内容来继续推进故事。我们会将这些内容融入故事、对话、后续影响等等方面。但玩家并不需要完成之前的扩展内容，也可以开始‘旧时曲’。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610011023536745.jpg
目前尚不清楚“旧时曲”会如何根据玩家在其他扩展中的选择进行调整。可以推测，如果杰洛特需要被迫离开自己在私人庄园里喝酒养老的生活，他的心情肯定会相当糟糕。

news.title: 育碧员工发起集体抗议！抵制每天到岗 要求可居家办公
news.summary: 据Game Developer报道，育碧蒙特利尔员工组成的Ubisoft Workers of Montreal工会已发起一项请愿活动，要求“保留混合办公制度”。截…

content.v: 据Game Developer报道，育碧蒙特利尔员工组成的Ubisoft Workers of Montreal工会已发起一项请愿活动，要求“保留混合办公制度”。截至周三，该请愿已获得超过300名育碧员工的签名。据称，其中许多签名都是员工在线下收集完成的。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610010918444242.jpg
报告称，“今天标志着育碧蒙特利尔工人组织（UWM）‘保留混合办公’行动的公开启动，而我们的第一项行动就是发起一份请愿书。我们邀请每一位育碧蒙特利尔员工签署这份请愿书，也鼓励每一位支持者联系自己的人际网络，邀请更多人参与签名！”
今年1月，育碧宣布要求所有员工每周五天返回办公室办公。同时，公司还宣布将进行裁员、推迟部分项目以及关闭工作室。当时，育碧刚刚获得腾讯提供的12.5亿美元投资。育碧表示，此次“调整规模”计划旨在“重新夺回公司的创意领导地位、恢复灵活性，并推动强劲反弹”。育碧在1月发布的公告中表示，恢复办公室办公政策的目的是促进团队协作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610010919154610.jpg
该政策公布后不久，位于巴黎的育碧员工举行了罢工，以抗议这一决定。
当育碧蒙特利尔团队负责人David Michaud-Cromp公开评论该政策时，他表示裁员背后可能存在除提升生产效率之外的其他原因。随后，育碧让这名资深员工接受无薪停职处理，并在一周后将其解雇。育碧在向Game Developer发表的声明中表示：“以尊重的方式分享反馈或观点，并不会导致员工被解雇。”
育碧继续说道：“我们拥有明确的《行为准则》，其中规定了我们对于安全、尊重地共同工作的期望，所有员工每年都会阅读并签署该准则。当相关规定遭到违反时，我们会按照既定流程处理，包括根据违规行为的性质、严重程度以及重复发生情况，采取逐步升级的措施。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610010919311442.jpg
该组织目前正在指导有意签署请愿书的育碧员工，要求他们通过线下方式参与，即“在休息时间与同事见面”，以完成签名。

news.title: 这个屁股垫是我在 2026 年对游戏设置所做的最大升级，这充分说明了我们现在所处的位置
news.summary: In short, I've been sitting on it.

content.v: Like many of you, I love upgrading my PC and anything to do with my gaming setup. And in my privileged position as a PC Gamer hardware writer, I often get my hands on the latest gear for the purposes of review.
But in terms of what I've spent my own cash on this year, and my own personal possessions, the biggest upgrade I've made to my gaming setup in 2026 is this cushion :
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WqRQPWk3iPPJFrAv2hePET-1920-80.jpg

Despite appearances, this is not for legitimate medical reasons. I am afflicted with a bony arse, a critical lack of junk in my personal trunk. And gaming chairs these days have a tendency to be hard as rocks, which leave my cheeks feeling sore after a long day.

So, I gave in and bought a cushion. It's magnificent, and has improved my comfort levels at least ten-fold in comparison to the firm seat of my steely-buttocked gaming chair. It also cost me £40, because the UK listing came with a lumbar support cushion that I swapped out for one I already owned.

Which also makes it one of the most expensive upgrades I've bought this year. Because 2026 has been the year of stupendous price rises across many sectors of the PC gaming hardware market, and I haven't been able to open my wallet wide enough to pay for component upgrades. So, for the most part, I've stuck with my rig as it is.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/my3Q7xSmMeJyiaoSMZtu7o-1920-80.jpg

I'm lucky enough to own a good gaming PC already, and it doesn't struggle with the games I want to play. I'm also not averse to a dose of DLSS or frame generation to help boost the frame rate in the really demanding stuff. But I have to wonder how many people are out there, like me, waiting out this pricing storm. And how long we'll wait for, before we decide to bite the bullet and pay up for a component upgrade.

Still, when 64 GB of decent DDR5 costs well north of $800 , I'm really not looking to upgrade from my 32 GB kit, bought for $100 or so three years ago. My SSD is a 2 TB model, which cost me $130 at around the same time. I'd love a 4 TB drive—but when the good ones cost upwards of $400 a pop , I really can't justify it.

Graphics cards? If I needed one right now, I'd be buying an RTX 5060 Ti 8 GB or an RX 9070 GRE , the two of the last GPUs still available for somewhat sensible money relative to their performance. Both represent good value given what's going on with GPU pricing at the moment, and I highly recommend them. But I can't believe how far we've fallen, when Nvidia's current "mid-range" option, the RTX 5070 , costs $779 .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/D3Wi7v4Sxy5nsV2fmQBb78-1920-80.jpg
And that's the cheapest version we can find. In this sort of market, getting by with what you've got often makes the most sense.

There is a saving grace on the horizon. Well, potentially, anyway. We're about to enter the major sales season, with October Prime Day and the juggernaut that is Black Friday beginning to loom into view. And I'm hoping, with all of my fingers crossed, that we still see some significant discounts on hardware this year—despite everything going on in the industry right now.

As any good hardware nerd will tell you, finding the right upgrade for your setup is one of the great joys of PC gaming. And I'm sure plenty of you are trucking along with rigs that would have otherwise received some new hardware by now, if AI server demand hadn't ravaged the consumer market behind so much of our hobby.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/RhYU3PbQuU3H88Hnj4kg6B-1920-80.jpg

The other upside (and I'll take any I can get) is that gaming monitors , mice, keyboards, and controllers have resisted the tidal wave of price increases this year. We also tend to see major discounts on these items over the big sales season, so some sort of meaningful upgrade should be achievable for many of us—even if it's not the new GPU or memory kit our hearts may desire.

I really don't blame you if, like me, you've been sticking with what you've got for longer than you expected. Here's hoping we get some sort of relief this sales season—because personally, I feel like I've been sitting on my hands (and my now-cossetted butt) for a little too long.

news.title: 我来这里是为了节省我们所有的时间，通过确定如果你有枪的话我们最常玩的电子游戏中哪一个会更有效地完成
news.summary: Astarion probably shouldn't have a glock.

content.v: If there's one thing I know about the age of information, it's that none of us have time for anything anymore, nor the attention spans to see them through. If I'm not getting a constant jitterbug hit of dopamine every two seconds from my doomscrolling, am I really awake? Don't answer that. I don't want to think about the answer to that.

And if there's one thing I know about videogames, it's that man, they're getting long. If only there was a way to make these things shorter, somehow? Like, say, giving our protagonist a gun? And not just a period-accurate flintlock or something, I mean an actual handgun. Let's just say a .45 pistol. If you know more about guns than me you're welcome to imagine something sexier.

I asked a few of my colleagues for their longest-played eligible games—that is, videogames that have an ending, do not feature guns as a common, standard feature throughout their runtime, and could be feasibly impacted by the inclusion of a pistol. Let's see how much time we can save…

On average: Yes, having a gun in games that do not have guns will save you time—and, depending on the game, irrevocably corrupt you. Or make you feel deeply uncomfortable about the parallels that might be drawn to the real world. However, you also might also get to see Genghis Khan with an AK-47. So there's benefits and drawbacks.

news.title: 《巫师 3 重制版》已经因过于明亮而被修复
news.summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered launched for free earlier this week, and has since been subject to debate

content.v: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered launched for free earlier this week, and has since been subject to debate over whether its visual changes have been for the better. One aspect that has routinely dominated the conversation is how overly bright the remaster makes the game look, and it's evident developer CD Projekt Red agrees that it went too far.

A patch for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and the Xbox Play Anywhere version of the game on PC has been released that makes "various lighting adjustments" across the game, among other things. CD Projekt Red detailed the patch on social media , stating that the team is working on another hotfix for PC that will address a save game issue that numerous players have reported. The brief patch notes can be found below.

The patch isn't being released for other PC versions because it's likely that the fix centers around the game's bloom setting. It's one that PC players have suggested turning off to regain some contrast in the game's image, but one that wasn't available for players on consoles. A different hotfix released on October 1 has a slightly different list of notes:
This patch doesn't introduce a toggle, but likely toggles it off for all console players. If you're playing on Nintendo Switch 2, however, you won't be able to benefit from the fix just yet.

The bloom setting doesn't fix everything though. Players have still taken issue with the game's HDR implementation, path tracing visual presentation, and overall system performance on PC. CD Projekt Red hasn't yet commented on whether it is planning to make changes to those areas, but this patch does indicate that they are aware of the most glaring issues players are facing.

The Witcher 3 Remastered released as a free update for all versions of the game, introducing enhanced character animations, world detail, improved combat and role-playing systems, and more. An expansion for the 11 year old game, Songs of the Past , is scheduled to release in 2027 and will tie into the events of the The Witcher 4 , which is currently in development.

news.title: AOC 紧随 1,000 Hz IPS 游戏显示器潮流，但这次像素响应为 0.1 毫秒
news.summary: The fastest LCD panel yet?

content.v: I reviewed the world's first 1,000 Hz monitor just the other day, a refresh rate that would have seemed barely comprehensible a couple of years ago. Now here comes another, this time from AOC. Pretty soon, no doubt, serious esport types won't get out of bed for less than quad-digit refresh rates.

However, I'd argue that it's actually the claimed 0.1 ms response time, not the 1,000 Hz refresh, that makes this new monitor interesting. Hold that thought while I introduce the new AOC AGON PRO AGP257FT. Actually, they'd rather have it known as the AGON PRO AGP257FT by AOC, a la Asus and the ROG brand.

Whatever, the AGP257FT looks like a dead ringer for that LG UltraGear 25G590B I mentioned, for the most part. Along with the 1,000 Hz headline refresh, we're talking 25-inches and 1080p's worth of old school IPS panelry (if panelry can indeed be a word) and HDR 400 certification, which means no local dimming.

However, AOC hasn't just pinched LG's 1,000 Hz panel and stuck it in their own chassis. Instead, the AGP257FT is the result of a collab' with Chinese display specialist BOE. The result is a new oxide-based IPS panel.

It is, perhaps, that fact—that this isn't just the LG panel rehashed—that explains why this AOC has an overclocking feature that tops out at 1,050 Hz while the LG model can go to 1,100 Hz overclocked.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WPuSDwSHUfXapWx4NTwrYk-1920-80.jpg

Still, what's really caught my eye is the response claim. A notable aspect of the LG monitor is that the response time is only rated at 1 ms. Okay, that aligns perfectly with 1,000 Hz in theory. In practice, typical grey-to-grey response ratings aren't terribly indicative of real-world performance. You'd want plenty of performance overhead in hand, in other words.

Well, this new AOC has just that. The peak response performance is quoted at 0.1 ms. That's for the MPRT metric which is arguably even less representative. But AOC also quotes 0.3 ms for grey-to-grey, which is at least promising.

Indeed, I happened to review the 540 Hz Sony Inzone M10S II shortly after the LG, and the motion clarity on that 0.03 ms OLED is on another planet from the 1,000 Hz IPS LG. On paper, then, this new AOC looks potentially more appealing.

You get the same 1,000 Hz refresh and the preposterously low latency that implies, plus hopefully better motion clarity to close the gap to OLED a bit. I'm pretty confident I'd still take that Sony even for esports, what with its perfect per pixel lighting and crackers pixel response, plus a larger 27-inch panel and 1440p res for when you aren't esporting.

But if you absolutely, positively must have 1,000 Hz, you have to think this AOC is worth a look versus that LG. And you'll have to do that looking early next year. The AOC AGON PRO AGP257FT comes out Q1 2027. Pricing is TBC.

战役评价：
《战争机器：事变日》选择回到故事的起点，让系列重新找回最核心的味道——马库斯·菲尼克斯、多姆·圣地亚哥，以及既恐怖又危险的兽族大军。尽管玩家早已知道故事最终会走向何方，《事变日》依然成功打造了一段情感充沛的前传故事，并通过鲜明的人物塑造，让这段已经注定结局的冒险依然充满感染力。
在玩法层面，本作同样对敌人、武器以及战斗系统进行了进一步进化，最终呈现出一套足以与系列其他作品正面较量的《战争机器》战役体验。而本作故事结束时，距离马库斯因相关事件入狱、并最终迎来初代《战争机器》的故事，还有整整10年时间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610012117325897.png
希望系列下一作能够继续留在这段过去的时间线中，也希望我们不用再等上整整七年，才能迎来下一款《战争机器》。

news.summary: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie is a critical and commercial hit, but the director is not jumping right int

content.v: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie is a critical and commercial hit, but the director is not jumping right into a sequel, and may never. Instead, his next project is called The Flood, and while The Flood are well-known to gamers in Halo's lore , Cregger's new movie has nothing to do with Halo--though it does involve aliens.

Cregger is known for keeping secrets about his movies, and he’s not saying much about what to expect from The Flood beyond that it’s a sci-fi movie set in deep space. Dread Central reported that The Flood is "very Alien-esque," with the story focusing on a deep-space ship captain who, with her crew, investigates a strange signal "from a distant world." The signal leads the crew to an "alien artifact that warps time, reality, and their sanity, forcing them into a confrontation with an incomprehensible intelligence."

Oscar-winning actor Jennifer Lawrence has signed on for The Flood, according to Variety . Though her exact role in the film remains unknown, she will likely play the lead, the ship captain. This is somewhat familiar ground for Lawrence, as she starred in 2016's sci-fi movie Passengers, in which she played a character aboard a spaceship opposite Chris Pratt.

Cregger is re-teaming with Warner Bros./New Line for The Flood; he previously made the successful thriller Weapons at the studio. He said in a statement that Lawrence is a "one-of-a-kind" talent and that he's excited to work with her.
In addition to Warner Bros./New Line, Cregger is working with Steven Spielberg's Amblin Entertainment and Roy Lee's Vertigo on The Flood.

As for Lawrence, she earned her first Academy Award nomination for 2010's Winter's Bone. She won an Oscar for 2012's Silver Linings Playbook, and also picked up nominations for American Hustle and Joy. She is also known for playing Katniss in the Hunger Games movie series.

As for a possible sequel to Resident Evil, given the movie has made so much money and strong reviews, many are expecting another entry. That may happen, but Cregger has said he is done with franchise movies , even though he does have ideas for a sequel .
“I’m doing this [Resident Evil], and that’s it for me. I’m not going to go tackle any other franchises," he said.

news.title: 《战争机器》新作GS 7分：创新不足剧情令人失望
news.summary: 《战争机器：事变日》将于2026年10月6日正式发售，目前游戏媒体评分已经解禁。外媒GameSpot为本作打出7分（满分10分）。

content.v: 《战争机器：事变日》将于2026年10月6日正式发售，目前游戏媒体评分已经解禁。外媒GameSpot为本作打出7分（满分10分）。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610012110362125.png
GameSpot认为，《战争机器：事变日》选择回到系列早期时代，以前传形式讲述故事，但整体依然延续了系列熟悉的玩法，并没有进行太多突破。
优点：
消灭兽族依旧非常爽快；
武器改装提供了更多战斗选择和自定义空间；
Kalona的建筑设计令人印象深刻。
缺点：
作为前传，故事表现不够理想；
开放区域比较乏味，影响整体游戏节奏。
GameSpot表示，《战争机器：事变日》的部分开放区域确实加入了一些有意思的设计，但除此之外，游戏的线性关卡明显更加出色。这些关卡重新抓住了经典《战争机器》的核心体验，同时通过更具电影感的演出进一步强化了战斗场面的规模。
在GameSpot看来，这些内容也是《战争机器：事变日》表现最好的一面。虽然游戏加入了一些新想法，但整体给人的感觉依旧是The Coalition并没有试图彻底改变系列玩法。这并不是一件坏事，但GameSpot也表示，自己的确感受到对这类游戏的兴趣已经不如10年前那么强烈。毕竟，同样的机枪塔玩法重复太多次之后，玩家难免会产生审美疲劳。
总体而言，《战争机器：事变日》依然是一款非常典型的《战争机器》作品。尽管剧情令人失望，部分开放区域也比较无聊，但核心战斗依旧能够带来不错的体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610012111111056.png
GameSpot最终认为，本作是一款“不错的游戏”，但它的表现很大程度上依靠已经延续了20年的系列经典战斗玩法。这样的内容足以让游戏保持不错的水准，但如果《战争机器》系列能够在此基础上进一步深入和创新，或许会带来更加令人满意的体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/01/small_202610012111128281.png

news.title: 007 第一缕曙光的免费扩张让邦德获得了杀人驾驶执照
news.summary: 007 First Light developer IO Interactive has revealed a major new free update for the James Bond game, which i

content.v: 007 First Light developer IO Interactive has revealed a major new free update for the James Bond game, which is now available across PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. Extended Operations adds new missions, the Valhalla Protocol, a photo mode, New Game+, new weapons, outfits, and more. Here's a closer look at everything that's new:
Valhalla Protocol

The main event of Extended Operations, Valhalla Protocol brings back Bond's signature Aston Martin Valhalla ride for a race against the clock in Slovakia. The track will have four different versions that you can test your driving skills in, and when putting the pedal to the metal isn't enough, you can always rely on its arsenal of guns and missile launchers to help you earn a first-place finish--far better than a boring Formula One race.
Photo mode
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/First-Light-6.jpg?w=636

007 First Light has no shortage of exciting moments, and you can capture them in all their digital glory in the game's new photo mode. Similar to the photo modes found in many modern games, you can set up Bond and use unique filters, custom light setups, exclusive poses, and much more to take the perfect shot.
New operation: Jungle Heist
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/First-Light-4.jpg?w=636

A new mission for 007 First Light, Jungle Heist tasks Bond with infiltrating a jungle villa, finding out who's concealing the codes to a secret safe, retrieving its contents, and then fighting your way up to the extraction point.
New weapons
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/First-Light-3.jpg?w=636
Bond's arsenal is also being updated with two new weapons: the Squire Marksman rifle and the Storm 12 shotgun.
New outfits
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/First-Light-2.jpg?w=636

Time to dress for success--or big-budget Hollywood explosions--with a fresh set of Q Division threads. Bond can don some casual clothes with the Leisure Beam outfit, posh it up with the First Class tuxedo, and blend in with the Observant Spy ensemble.
New Game Plus
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/First-Light-1.jpg?w=636
You can replay the entire 007 First Light campaign--which is really good!-- and you can also choose to wear different outfits that you've unlocked from your first session with the game.
00 difficulty mode
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/First-Light-5.jpg?w=636

Think you've earned your 00 number? You can put your skills to the test with the 00 difficulty mode, which is designed to punish even the smallest mistake. Resources are more limited, enemies are deadly, and the mode is billed as the ultimate challenge for players.

IO Interactive has steadily added new content to 007 First Light since it launched in May, and Amazon Game Studios boss Jeff Gattis recently suggested that a sequel is a matter of when , not if. The game reached an impressive milestone of 4 million units sold in August 2026 across PC and consoles--minus Switch 2, as 007 First Light is still MIA on that platform.
The Switch 2 edition has been delayed several times, and it's now expected to arrive in March 2027 as IO works on getting it ready for the Nintendo handheld.
"As Hollywood seems uncertain about where to take Bond next, IO Interactive’s debut effort is supremely confident," Mark Delaney wrote in GameSpot's 007 First Light review .

news.title: 《战争机器：事变日》M站开分89分 一部杰作！
news.summary: 《战争机器：事变日》的媒体评分已经解禁，M站开分89分。目前共收录15家媒体评分，全好评。

content.v: 《战争机器：事变日》的媒体评分已经解禁，M站开分89分。目前共收录15家媒体评分，全好评。另外，IGN为本作的单人战役给出了9分（暂定），多人战役暂未评分。

部分评价：
DayOne 100分
The Coalition将系列推向了新的高度，打造出一段引人入胜、残酷血腥却又出人意料地细腻的战役，充满精妙的玩法机制与绝妙的惊喜。这是《战争机器》系列有史以来手感最好的一作，也是它在银幕上画面与音效表现最出色的一次。《战争机器：事变日》？它他妈就是一部杰作。
Generación Xbox 100分
对我来说，《战争机器：事变日》是系列最佳，也是The Coalition迄今为止最出色的作品。它的战役让马库斯和多姆回归，却不仅仅依赖怀旧，而是以更黑暗、更残酷的方式讲述了兽族威胁的起源。
Gamer Social Club 95分
《事变日》成功地将“事变日”的故事讲得扣人心弦、绝望无助，最重要的是——好玩。这是系列20年积淀的集大成之作，将系列精髓淬炼成一部必玩的Xbox作品，带你踏上一段辉煌残酷、情感满足且史诗般的电影化冒险。

news.title: 《战争机器：事变日》战役评测：回到开始的那一天

content.v: https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1001/20261001202329-5433-45872.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
在《战争机器》系列的历史上，“事变日”始终是一个被反复提及却从未被正面呈现的关键节点——兽族从地底倾巢而出的那一天，成为了整个系列的起点。

十四年来，玩家在《战争机器》正传三部曲中见到的，都是事变日之后那个满目疮痍的世界，以及马库斯和他的朋友们作为老兵，是如何在废墟之上与敌人周旋的。而《战争机器：事变日》所做的，是将时间拨回一切开始的那一刻，让玩家亲眼目睹改变了锡拉星命运的日子。The Coalition将这部前传定位为系列的“起源故事”，讲述了两个起源：兽族战争的开端，以及马库斯与多姆之间兄弟情谊的结成。在经历了《战争机器5》在叙事和探索玩法上的摇摆之后，本作回归原三部曲的沉重基调与残酷氛围。我通关了战役模式，深切感到这是一个明智的选择。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1001/20261001202329-9155-61710.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
剧情与整体体验
《战争机器：事变日》的战役体量基本保持了系列水准，但在同类TPS/FPS游戏里显得足够长：游戏共分为五幕，包含超过20个小章节，单人普通难度总通关时长在15至20小时之间。考虑到系列最近几代的重心已经大幅倾斜至持久战和联网部分，单机战役时长占比已经相当慷慨。
战役的节奏可以用两个字概括：密集。战斗比例相当高，线性主线部分，玩家几乎没有喘息的空间，从一个战场奔赴另一个战场的行进感贯穿始终，这是老《战争机器》最令玩家熟悉的节奏。难度曲线也设计得较为合理，战斗的紧张感从开始一直延续到最后，除了第二幕的半开放地图，以及第三、四幕开场的长跑图段落略显拖沓之外，几乎没有明显的松弛。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1001/20261001202329-4216-96726.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
本作剧情聚焦于事变爆发到随后三天的撤离行动，是一部典型的前传性质故事。主线讲述马库斯和多姆当时在酒吧与另外两位新兵偶遇，随后被编入同一小队，开始四处救火，最终击败关底Boss并成功撤离。整体而言剧情相对平淡，充满往返各地救援却总是慢敌一步的无力感，玩下来颇为憋屈。相比初代，本作更加血腥、战况也更加被动，充满了血浆与牺牲。如果玩家没有接触过系列其他作品，很难想象人类最终是如何在这场战争中获胜的。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1001/20261001202330-2497-48745.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
但正是在这种压抑的氛围中，虚幻引擎5的视觉表现力得到了充分发挥。游戏基于虚幻引擎5打造，大场景的破碎感、铺天盖地投入战场的兽族、交织的火力与爆炸光影、优秀的面部表情捕捉，都让卡洛纳市的沦陷具备了此前系列作品难以企及的视觉冲击力。尤其是布拉沃小队落入地下坑道，目睹数万兽族军队出发的一幕，堪称本作中最具震撼力的场景之一。
角色塑造方面，游戏围绕马库斯与多姆的家人、出身和友情进行了一定程度的补充。玩家可以了解到多姆对妻子和兄弟的牵挂，马库斯则在登记入队时，主动写下父亲亚当·菲尼克斯的名字，算是给后续剧情做了伏笔。但整体而言，角色塑造仍显浅尝辄止、浮于表面，对于熟悉系列的老玩家来说，能获得的新信息相当有限，与一代开篇剧情也并无合理过渡。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1001/20261001202329-4531-20882.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
值得吐槽的是，本作简中字幕绑定中文语音，无法单独修改。多姆的中文配音过于青涩单薄，感觉就是另一个时间线的迪伦·法登；许多角色的声线与语气过于轻松，几乎感受不到战争的紧张，也听不出这帮老兵的丰富阅历，某个怪物的名字太过粗俗，加几句脏话并不能让文本显得地道，倒像是大家吃饭时互相闲聊，体验下来略显遗憾。
地图探索与推进
在地图设计上，《战争机器：事变日》仍然在部分章节保留了半开放地图的影子。但吸取5代教训，本作在很大程度上做了“收敛”， 大多数时候更聚焦于线性主线叙事，沿着从一个战场奔赴另一个战场的路线推进。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1001/20261001202330-3658-12283.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
比如，在第二幕卡洛纳城内四处救场时，玩家会反复从左到右、再从右到左往返于一些场景之间，如大桥、喷泉广场、体育场等，有时会因战势变化发生轻微的地图破坏。在跑图过程中，游戏提供了大量的收集品和少数支线任务，并配有自动大地图位置标记与靠近透视引导。支线任务并非强制，普遍流程偏短，大多都是防守一到两波敌人或者护送平民。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1001/20261001202331-5399-60953.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
在这些可选择要素的点缀下，《战争机器：事变日》的主线整体给人的感觉仍然是线性收束的，这里处理得较好的原因主要有二：一是时长比例的把握合适，且非强制；二是主线本身的战斗节奏相当满，两场战斗之间的跑路距离也短，把它们当成紧张节奏的缓冲也并无不可。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1001/20261001202331-9487-23566.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
掩体射击与角色强化
《战争机器：事变日》在玩法上围绕TPS掩体战术射击+完美装填+简单改配件强化展开，完美换弹机制带来的策略性与节奏感，掩体之间扎实的滑铲与冲锋移动，以及沉重、硬派、分量十足的近战与远程打击感悉数回归。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1001/20261001202330-6744-56997.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

玩家可以同时携带两把长枪、一把手枪、两种手雷、一种战术装备和一件护甲，所有均可进行多个部位的配件改装，配件通过收集地图上的硬皮箱获得。长枪10种，手枪3种，手雷6种，战术装备4种。能发射伊姆能源造成范围腐蚀伤害的“焚化者”喷子，和独立的榴弹发射器“重击者”是新增武器，经典链锯枪在剧情中尚处于试作型阶段，射速和弹匣容量在改装后都比经典MK3更快、更足；战术装备可使用的配件包括肾上腺素注射回血、音波晕眩、团队医疗气体雾化器和标记敌人的脉冲无人机四种；护甲则通过更换配件提供额外防御、回弹、额外手雷或完美换弹增益等。另外还有一些地图限定或者一次性拾取的重武器。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1001/20261001202331-7145-34190.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
本作可使用的长枪总数比以往略少，但四个配件随着剧情推进和收集逐渐解锁，除了稳定性、后坐力、弹匣容量、瞄准镜等经典改造外，还有不同的完美换弹效果，例如附赠爆炸效果、直接伤害改为晕眩伤害、暴击返还完美换弹等，总数大约100种，花样繁多。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1001/20261001202331-3608-41180.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
不过，在单人通关的情况下，敌人TTK较长，队友AI又不会进行战术配合，因此实际好用的组合仍然有限，大狙加链锯枪，搭配碎片手雷封洞与打针回血，基本可以覆盖大多数远中近全部战斗场景。其他配件只能留给多人合作高难度战役，或者联网持久战模式中发挥作用。
多人合作
在测评解禁时，游戏的多人部分尚未解锁，但有一点可以确认：《战争机器：事变日》的战役部分，仍然是最好的PVE多人合作射击游戏之一。本作支持完整的四人合作战役模式，队友之间通过战术配合分工封路、掩护、突脸冲锋”， 既可以缓解长TTK以及敌人AI和血量提升带来的难度压力，也能让玩家与好友重新享受联机共斗的乐趣。段落化的线性章节，可以选关，可以互救，够爽也有挑战。这也是我最早爱上这个系列的原因。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1001/20261001202332-6098-54202.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
A9VG体验总结
扎实的掩体射击手感、密集的战斗节奏、多人联机战役下四人小队的战术配合，以及一个足够沉重、足够血腥的起源故事，让《战争机器：事变日》找回了些许往日的味道。半开放地图存在感偏低的问题依然存在，但整体比例很克制且非强制，让剧情在大部分时间基本稳定在从一个战场跑到另一个战场的核心体验上。虚幻5带来的画面演出与光影特效，让卡洛纳市的沦陷具有了此前系列作品难以企及的视觉冲击力。
对于那些从初代《战争机器》一路走来的老玩家而言，本作提供的是一种优秀画面加持下的熟悉感。它在战斗上的爽快感，完全可以让你全程爽突，而不太在意剧情和地图设计上的缺陷。未来的多人网战模式同样可以期待一下。
A9VG评分：8.5/10（战役部分）

news.title: 战争机器：E 日评论
news.summary: A prequel that returns to the heart of this series.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/gearsofwar-eday-campaign-blogroll-01-1790810107371.jpg

Editor's Note : This review currently only covers Gears of War: E-Day's story campaign, as that’s all reviewers were given access to ahead of release. It will be updated with a finalized score and multiplayer impressions once we spend some time with the Versus and Horde Siege modes.

To the casual observer, Gears of War has always been a heavy-metal third-person cover shooter about a bunch of meatheads with chainsaws attached to their guns fighting aliens. But what Gears fans know all too well is that the real secret to the series’s two decades of success isn’t the killer graphics, the smart cover mechanics, or the gloriously gratuitous gore – although those things are all certainly significant parts of the recipe. It’s the heart. Marcus and Dom’s brotherhood. JD or Del’s sacrifice (depending on what you chose to do in Gears 5). Dom’s relentless love for Maria. And so my biggest question heading into Gears of War: E-Day, a prequel to the first game set 14 years prior on the day the Locust emerged from underneath the planet Sera, was how it would hang onto that heart when we already knew our armor-clad bros would definitely be alive by the end. I’m thrilled to say that E-Day carries its own satisfying emotional weight, with additional welcomed backstory for Marcus and Dom leading the way – oh, and the action is pretty top-notch, too.

E-Day begins with our Coalition of Ordered Government (COG) heroes, Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago, completing a ceremonial tour to honor their service in the finally-ended 79-year Pendulum Wars. We get glimpses of how each of them is reckoning with the end of the only thing they’ve ever known: Marcus is ready to re-enlist and hoping Dom will join him, while Dom is ready to go home to his wife Maria and their two young children, who are growing up without him. Of course, things quickly go to Hell – or rather, Hell comes up to them. Gears of War: E-Day does an excellent job of conveying both the uncertainty and the horror of what’s happening to these characters, even when we as players know exactly what’s going on.
What I said about the Gears 5 (2019)

It’s not surprising at all that Gears 5 is an excellent third-person action game. This iconic series has never really had a misfire, even when changing hands from original developer Epic to The Coalition, and the hot streak remains unbroken. What was unexpected is just how effectively it doubles down on story with a character-focused, consequence-filled tale that plays to one of the franchise’s most underappreciated strengths and backs it up with fun, welcome additions to both its gameplay formula and flow. And that’s just the campaign: add in a heavy-hitting multiplayer lineup of Versus, Versus Arcade, Horde, and Escape and it makes Gears 5 one of the best and most versatile action-game packages in recent memory. - Ryan McCaffrey, September 13, 2019
Score: 9
Read the full Gears 5 review .

By happenstance, Marcus and Dom get unofficially paired up with ex-Gear Mags Carter and rookie Gear Lucas Reyes, who happen to be at the same bar when the Locust tremors begin, before the quartet officially becomes Bravo Squad once the COG starts organizing its defenses. E-Day deserves a lot of credit here: In a prequel like this where you’re already attached to the leads, it would be easy for Carter and Reyes to be throwaway side characters who exist only to further the stories of our two well-known heroes. But E-Day makes time for your lesser-known Bravo squadmates, dedicating entire meaningful and enjoyable sections to establishing them in this world and getting you to care about them.

The unfolding nightmare of E-Day is reflected in both the types of Locust monsters you face as the campaign progresses as well as the sorts of weapons you’ll need to put them back in the ground. Easily-dispatched Wretches and run-of-the-mill, Hammerburst-wielding Drones are on the front lines as Bravo Squad wonders what the hell it’s up against in the invasion’s opening hours. You’ll take them down with Gears of War staples like the Gnasher shotgun and Lancer, both the bayonet-clad original version and the prototype of the chainsaw-equipped revision. Yes, you’ll get your hands on Gears’s most famous firearm pretty early, and you even get to witness its fun little origin story.

But as you move through the first hours of the Locust invasion, Bravo Squad is continually confused and terrified at the increasingly deadly horrors trying to kill them. The monster menagerie is, naturally, a mix of foes you have and haven’t seen before in other Gears of War games, and the battles get steadily more white-knuckle as you make your way through the five-act story. Giant, frog-like hopping freaks that arc multi-gallon acidic loogies at you. Heavies that come in multiple varieties, most menacingly the one that fires a medium-range Gorehook – a hook on a chain that will typically down you in one hit.

On that note, one of my few complaints about Gears of War: E-Day is related to the down-but-not-out situations you’ll find yourself in throughout the campaign. When, not if, you get downed, your allies will occasionally be standing right next to you and not revive you. In fairness, it wasn’t a constant occurrence, but there were numerous times throughout my 15-18 hour first playthrough when I got stomped to death by a Locust heavy because one of my buddies either stood next to me and didn’t get me up, ran off and left me for dead, or never even got over to me as I mashed the X button to cling to life for a while. The immediate solution for this is to play through E-Day in four-player online co-op (two-player split-screen is the limit on a single Xbox), but I sure hope a patch resolves this inconsistent AI behavior sooner rather than later as well.
Guns Aplenty

As with the Locust enemies, E-Day’s weapons are a mix of old and new, and my goodness do I love them. Every weapon has a unique purpose to suit a particular combat strategy. And man, it still feels awesome to blast a Locust Heavy to bits with the Gnasher shotgun, cut a Drone into pieces with the Lancer Prototype’s chainsaw attachment, or explode a Locust sniper’s head with a scoped-Longshot kill. But there’s so much more in there beyond those Gears classics. The Breechshot, first introduced in the often-forgotten Gears of War: Judgment, ended up being one of my go-tos the longer the campaign went on, as it offered solid range and stopping power without being as cumbersome as something like the Longshot sniper rifle.

But there are a lot of weapons I’d give shoutouts to as well, like the Incinerator, which shotgun-blasts a burst of flesh-melting Imulsion; the Ripper, which is basically the Gears-universe equivalent of a SAW; and the ol’ favorite Torque Bow, which has a hell of a windup but then unleashes an explosive arrow at your target. I loved the weapon complement here, as well as the options that deep roster of firearms afforded me in some of the campaign’s later battles.

And it’s not just that all of these weapons are fun to use in the right situation. They can also all be modified and upgraded through E-Day’s new Weapon Mod and Tactical Gear system. You’ll encounter dozens of yellow Hard Cases lightly hidden throughout the world for you to find. Each contains a mod for one weapon or another, such as accuracy enhancers, scopes, or clip extenders. Completing optional secondary objectives around the major industrial city of Kalona where E-Day takes place also grants these same rewards. Each weapon has four mod slots, which you’ll unlock as you go, and I found myself constantly tweaking each weapon to find the right mix of add-ons that suited my playstyle. As such, I was plenty motivated to find every Hard Case I could and complete every secondary objective possible.

news.title: 《逃离游戏时间》是一款独特的多人《玩具总动员》 IGN 预览
news.summary: And though Escape From Playtime isn’t Mob Entertainment’s first attempt at a multiplayer game, building one in

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/escapefromplaytime-preview-blogroll-1790805383173.jpg
Key Preview Takeaways:

Toy Story might be pop culture’sthe most recognizable take on the idea that our toys have a life of their own when we're not around, but Mob Entertainment’s Poppy Playtime might be among the more unique approaches to take on the concept. Its story, about shoving sentience into the products in a toy factory and those very abominations rebelling against their creators, is a sort of dark horror that has really spoken to a dedicated and growing audience of fans across games, film, and more. And though Escape From Playtime isn’t the studio’s first attempt at a multiplayer game, building one inside the Poppy Playtime universe and putting players inside the furry bodies and twisted minds of the monsters of the factory hopes to be their most robust attempt.

We got to play a few rounds of the co-op extraction looter ahead of its open playtest starting October 1, and I found it surprisingly challenging in mostly fun ways despite the finicky controls and abundance of small bugs.

As a person unfamiliar with Poppy Playtime, I found Sr. Comms Manager Tyler Sanchez’s rundown of the lore to be helpful. Lots of attention has been paid to making the environments, enemies, and all the little details in between as accurate and respectful of the world they’ve made and that people have immersed themselves into as possible, as well as leaving breadcrumbs for real lore heads to devour. “The community is VERY passionate about the lore,” he punctuated his summary with. A quick perusal of the subreddit shows this to be true pretty immediately — quite a few of the top threads are people sharing early art or debating the merits of certain interpretations of story morsels.

Once we got split into groups and dropped into the factory, I really appreciated how creepy and also silly all of these things were in motion. Walls and furniture askew and messy and towering over our miniscule bodies. Colorful bits and bobs all covered by jagged shadows or washed with eerie, sickly reds or greens. Our teddy characters, the Smiling Critters, whose namesake mugs curl uncomfortably from ear to ear. Mob’s animation origins really make the macabre merriness stick to you as you watch monsters slink through the darkness in pursuit of you.
Night Shift

QA Manager Jostin Bilyeu’s rundown of the gameflow was pleasantly chaotic and elaborate, but boiled down to a simple goal: Our team must scavenge loot from around the factory and return it to Barry, a googly-eyed cart, without being caught and killed by the twisted experiments that roam the building’s corridors. Different bits of loot have different point values and rounds, called shifts here, have minimum point quotas that must be reached before you can leave the factory with the victory and move on to the next shift. Easier said than done, of course.

Grabbing loot is pretty straightforward, but you have a very limited amount of inventory space to keep them in. You really have to be discerning when managing the four slots if you're trying to be efficient. The added wrinkle is that most of the items you’ll find have some sort of utility that can be helpful in navigating the labyrinthian factory, like glow sticks you can mark important features or leave trails with. I got a kick out of the airhorn, which can be useful in helping your teammates find you with the unfortunate downside of also letting the enemy know your approximate location.

Even when our squad of four had our pockets filled to the brim, we never had enough to hit the threshold in one wave, so we’d have to double back deeper into the factory on the hunt for more valuables. The deeper we ventured, the more the factory itself became its own oppressive enemy. With so many halls and doors that seem to sprawl out endlessly, not to mention the verticality of it all with rooms that potentially go as high as they do wide inviting us to use our ability to climb on practically anything to scour from floor to ceiling. Most of the climbing I did was pretty sketchy, thanks to both my unfamiliarity to the controls and the bugginess that comes with every surface in the game being potentially sticky at the press of a button.

Hazards revealed themselves the deeper we went, like a series of rooms consumed by noxious red CatNap gas, toxic to us if we stayed in it for too long. To clear the gas we had to navigate a path of school room desks whose tops peeked out over the noxious cloud, hopping from desk to desk through a series of rooms in order to pull a series of switches scattered among them. Again, easier said than done, as the floaty jumping could make for some dicey near misses, but I appreciated the way events like this modified the overall task.
You’re Not Alone

And then there’s the other denizens of the dilapidated workhouse that really don’t want you to leave. Of the four enemy types that possibly roam those corridors, I encountered three. Little green Boogie Bots were the bulk of the opponents, rolling around in patrol loops, sounding an alarm when they spotted one of us, and speeding towards us in an attempt to blow us all to bits. The Cat Bees float around like ghosts and latch onto players, and the only way to get them off as they slowly tick your life away is if an ally throws something at them. And then there was Miss Delight, an apparent fan favorite character who wanders the halls almost like a Big Daddy from Bioshock. She is a terrifying threat, and even though my encounter with her was brief — I ran and hid under a box as soon as I got the slightest hint that she was around — the menacing aura was real and palpable.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/efp-screenshot-6-1790805938207.png

Monster types are limited, but I didn’t feel like I needed more variety to stay on my toes because each of them are so different and require different strategies to counterplay. I always had to keep a quick exit route in mind for the bots, and was incentivized not to stray too far from the group because of the bees. I also found that, for a game without direct combat (you can only throw your items at enemies and hope for the best), out-maneuvering these foes felt engaging enough that I didn't miss having the option to just simply bash something to death.

When we hit our quota and escaped, we moved on to the next shift, where the necessary number of points to extract raises. And so does the difficulty, as the procedurally generated factory map gets larger, and is filled with a greater variety of environmental hazards and more enemies. The longer you stay in the map looking for loot, the more deadly it gets, as monsters get better at finding you and the poisonous CatNap gas starts to fill the halls of the place. We struggled to stay alive in shift 2 long enough to see how grim it could get, though.
Survive Together or Die Alone

Escape from Playtime has a heavy emphasis on co-op and teamwork, evident in a special room we found that had giant piano keys scattered across it and a song we had to play by pressing the keys in a specific order. Was this puzzle solvable solo? Hell, the whole game can be played in single player, but the pain in the ass it would have been for a little bit of loot and opening a short cut would have made it untenable. That said, the only ways to communicate with other players areis through a single, contextless ping or the proximity voice chat. And without matchmaking, you’ll have to bring your own friends to the party (or I guess join a stranger’s hosted game?), which in its own right could be a challenge as tall as Huggy Wuggy.

news.title: 战争机器：E-Day 需要多长时间 – 任务列表和游玩时间
news.summary: Gears of War: E-Day is almost here--unless you're hopping in a few days early with the Premium Edition--and if

content.v: Gears of War: E-Day is almost here--unless you're hopping in a few days early with the Premium Edition--and if you're looking to try out the campaign, you can settle in for a few days of action and chainsaw executions. While Gears of War: E-Day is primarily a linear cover-based shooter, the game also sprinkles in some semi-open-world environments for you to explore between missions, giving you the opportunity to hunt down collectibles, upgrades, and take part in side missions. Here’s how long it’ll take you to beat Gears of War: E-Day.
How long to beat Gears of War: E-Day depending on your play style

If you tackle the Gears of War: E-Day campaign on normal difficulty, do a little bit of collectibles hunting and take part in the game's non-story missions, expect the campaign to take 10-14 hours to complete.

In my own playthrough, I motored through the campaign and finished it in 11 hours, occasionally stopping along the way to track down a hidden item, find an upgrade pack for my arsenal, and take part in a side quest. I'd done roughly 60% of that content before I reached the end, and Gears of War: E-Day has a war journal that provides a very comprehensive list of things you missed in each mission, so you can go back and find them for a completionist run.

That's a fairly standard playthrough time for a game in this series, and once you've rolled credits, the various multiplayer modes look like they'll consume plenty of your hours. You can increase the difficulty and spend more time in the campaign, but on higher challenge levels, enemies can be bullet-sponges that quickly burn through your stock of spare lives. Horde Siege looks like an especially enjoyable timesink, as this new take on the Gears of War horde mode revolves around three teams of four players taking on waves of enemies, co-operating with each other to accomplish objectives, and survive against increasingly overwhelming odds.
Gears of War: E-Day mission list
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Gears-E-Day_3b1e3f.jpg?w=636

The campaign for Gears of War: E-Day is spread across five acts, each comprising several chapters. Acts 1 and 5 are the shortest of the bunch, while Acts 2-4 are lengthy, meaty parts of the overall narrative. You could easily do an Act per night, and spread them out over a week. You can see the full list of Acts and Chapters below, and if you ever want to go back to an earlier one to hunt down a missing collectible or gear upgrade, you can easily do so from the main menu.

news.title: 战争机器：E-Day 审查正在进行中 — 拍摄不错，但战役很艰难
news.summary: Gears has never felt better to play, or more creatively stagnant.

content.v: This in-progress review covers Gears of War: E-Day's campaign, but there's still the multiplayer check out, which wasn't available pre-launch. E-Day is officially out on October 6, but advanced access begins October 1 for those who pre-order the $100 Premium Edition. E-Day will also be available on Game Pass.

What's the most stunning revelation in this Gears of War prequel? Marcus Fenix used to have a jump button. Yes, the king of cover-based shooting, a man more rooted to the ground than a scarecrow, spent his youth jumping to some bits of cover. So E-Day contains at least one literal leap forward for the franchise. Shame it's trapped in a slog of a campaign that's otherwise anything but.

But before I moan about that, plenty of good news first. Gears has never felt better to play. These third-person cover shooters have always been a blast when they're working, and a miserable swearing fit when you dodge roll into certain death instead of snapping into cover like you wanted to. Again.

That nonsense has finally been excised, mostly, thanks to slightly more acrobatic characters and some wise button remapping. It's amazing what a difference sticking run on L3 and giving climb its own designated button makes.

Gears of War's biggest haters are liable to characterise its cover-shooting as a dull game of whack-a-mole. Perhaps on Normal difficulty, but Hardcore is where the experience sings. Here, staying in the same spot of cover is rightfully punished. You've got to keep gaining better ground, constantly weighing up the risks of lining up a sniper shot, a chainsaw insta-kill, or making a desperate dash for cover. It's a turn-based tactics shooter with a missing pause button. There's a reason that it translated so smoothly to a tactics spin-off.

E-Day introduces new weaponry that makes cowering in cover harder than ever. It loves a blast of acid, this game, either delivered from a massive evil frog or a new gun that shotguns it at you. Devastating, but a loving kiss on the cheek compared to the Goreshot , a grappling hook only interested in grappling your torso from your body. So gloriously over-the-top, it almost makes up for the insta-kill tedium from the elite enemy who wields it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/wwToBkqNs98R9DHgGa2mrM-1920-80.jpg

That stuff's good, but it's the renovations to the old guard that stand out. The spike trap now opens with a hugely satisfying thunk-thunk-thunk as its horrible insides prepare themselves for a good gouging. The explosive arrow-firing torque bow gets a great glow up—the sound design as it finds its target is wonderful, practically a doomsday drum roll, so good I still enjoy it even when a locust is aiming it at me. And if I'm ever called upon to assassinate God, this game's sublime sniper rifle is what I'm reaching for.
So if the gunplay's a treat and the core combat never better, what's the problem? Well, almost everything else, unfortunately.
Dis-may
Instead of the cynical, traumatised, seen-it-all-before combat veteran of the original Gears, here Marcus is… a cynical, traumatised, seen-it-all-before combat veteran.

E-Day is a prequel, referring to the fateful day when the locust got bored of living underground and burst free from the surface to say a very messy hello. This is covered in the opening cutscene of the original Gears of War. And if you're wondering what insights E-Day has that weren't covered in said cutscene, same here.

The game opens with Marcus Fenix and Dom 'boy isn't it great that my wife and kids are alive' Santiago. Instead of the cynical, traumatised, seen-it-all-before combat veteran of the original Gears, here Marcus is… a cynical, traumatised, seen-it-all-before combat veteran. Oh.

Discovering Marcus was once a flamboyant drag queen who was changed forever by E-Day into the man we know today was probably too much to hope for. But the fact he's essentially exactly the frikkin' same is the first alarm bell that this prequel is struggling to justify its own existence.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XsfxYXMufC8nfy6FkDAzDM-1920-80.jpg

Once the locust arrive, E-Day tries cosplaying as Resident Evil for a bit, complete with a trip through the panicking city to the police station. Some of these horror moments work. The drone gets an excellent introduction, though not so much for the poor sap stuck in the interrogation room with it. Other attempts at horror atmosphere are hilariously clumsy. I find the blood-soaked helmet of a transit worker, and the game immediately shatters any sense of foreboding with text popping up saying 'Bloody Transit Worker's Helmet Found!' Er, hooray?

The game then has some dumb fun giving little origin stories to its iconography—chainsaws being attached to machine guns! Grenades being tossed in emergence holes! Problem is, by the start of Act 2, you have the weaponry, armor, and the squad. At which point E-Day just becomes standard Gears of War again. You explore the ruined city (not open-world, more wide-ish linear) with goals never more complicated than 'shoot those locusts' or 'survive this wave of locusts' or 'why haven't you shot those locusts yet?'
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QTw5uxM3qZ8DMTspriukhM-1920-80.jpg

Gears 5 understood the value of variety. It had sections where you had to stealth around a mad scientist's factory to stealth kill infected robots. Or ride a skiff down an icy mountain. Or fight an enemy on the stage of a Hamilton-inspired musical which starts rotating at the worst moment possible (play Gears 5— it's one of the best 7/10s ever ).
Is the shooting strong enough to sustain this? Yeah, just, though it does get exhausting.

True, not all of Gears 5's ideas worked. But I wanted a sequel that improved upon them, not a regression that believes the only thing you should ever be doing in one of these games is endlessly pulling the trigger. It's just slightly remixed combat encounters all the way down. Battle a giant frog and several snipers! OK, now two frogs, one sniper, and several shotgunners! OK, OK, now three giant spiders that fire insta-kill rockets, and loads of grunts, and the last checkpoint was seven minutes back! …Hey, why are you suddenly aiming at me?

Is the shooting strong enough to sustain this? Yeah, just, though it does get exhausting. It's an action movie with everything ripped out that isn't bullets going into bastards. The 20+ hour campaign is also waaaaay too long considering how one-note it is (well, aside from two crap shooting-from-a-turret-inside-a-helicopter bits, but I was planning on being nice and not bringing those up).
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/YLDDyo4amfy7iL68E6AdaM-1920-80.jpg
Moderate improvements

New for E-Day are mod slots for your weapons and armour. Mods include less recoil, better scopes, faster chainsaw revving, etc. Not as useless and incremental as the crap you get in [insert whichever live service shooter you currently have the most beef with here], but it's borderline and hard to get excited about. Far better is the gizmo that can send out rippling shockwaves that stun enemies, perfect for a chainsawin'. I found a mod for it that also sets enemies on fire. Lovely.

You get these mods for completing sidequests or finding them in cases. But E-Day is so terrified of you missing anything that tiresome all-caps text saying HARD CASE NEARBY blazes across the screen. And the location of the case is immediately added to your map. Oh and if you activate whatever this game's version of Eagle Vision is called, we'll show you exactly where the case is. Ugh.
